leak information: The employee was fired after he was caught trying to leak information about the new phone to reporters.
那名員工被抓到試圖向記者洩漏新手機的資訊後遭到開除。
the news leaked out: Although the couple wanted to keep their wedding secret, the news leaked out within a few days.
雖然那對情侶想對婚禮保密，但消息在幾天內就走漏了。
the roof leaks: Every time it rains heavily, the roof leaks, so we have to put buckets on the bedroom floor.
每次下大雨屋頂就漏水，所以我們得在臥室地板上放水桶。
leak a document: Someone in the government decided to leak a document showing that officials had lied to the public.
政府內部有人決定外洩一份文件，顯示官員曾對民眾說謊。
lean on friends for support: When her parents got divorced, Amy learned to lean on friends for support instead of keeping her feelings inside.
父母離婚時，艾咪學會依靠朋友的支持，而不是把感受悶在心裡。
lean toward a decision: I am beginning to lean toward a decision to study abroad, but I still need to talk with my parents.
我開始傾向出國讀書的決定，但我仍需要和父母談談。
lean against the wall: Tired after the long hike, the students sat down to lean against the wall and rest for a while.
長途健行後很累，學生們坐下來靠著牆休息一會兒。
lean on someone: The gang began to lean on the shop owner, threatening to break his windows unless he paid them.
那幫人開始對店主施壓，威脅說除非他付錢，否則就砸破他的窗戶。
lean times: During lean times, my grandparents saved every coin and seldom bought anything they did not really need.
在艱困時期，我祖父母省下每一枚硬幣，很少買真正不需要的東西。
leap at the opportunity: If the coach offers him a place on the national team, Kevin will leap at the opportunity without a second thought.
如果教練提供他國家隊的名額，凱文會毫不猶豫地欣然把握機會。
prices leaped: After the typhoon destroyed many farms, vegetable prices leaped to nearly double their usual level.
颱風摧毀許多農場後，蔬菜價格大漲到平常的將近兩倍。
a leap of faith: Quitting a stable job to open a small bakery was a leap of faith, but it turned out well.
辭掉穩定的工作去開一家小麵包店是信心的一躍，但結果很好。
leap to conclusions: Don't leap to conclusions about the new student just because he is quiet on his first day.
別只因為新同學第一天很安靜，就對他妄下結論。
by leaps and bounds: Since she started reading English novels every night, her vocabulary has grown by leaps and bounds.
自從她每晚開始讀英文小說後，她的字彙量就突飛猛進。
lecture someone about: My dad likes to lecture me about my messy room while I just stand there in silence.
我爸爸喜歡為了我凌亂的房間訓斥我，而我只能默默站在那裡。
lecture on history: The famous professor will lecture on history in the school hall every Tuesday afternoon this semester.
這學期每週二下午，那位知名教授將在學校禮堂講授歷史。
lecture students: Instead of trying to lecture students for hours, the teacher lets them discuss questions in small groups.
那位老師不是想對學生講課好幾個小時，而是讓他們分小組討論問題。
lend support: Many local businesses agreed to lend support to the charity run by donating water and snacks.
許多在地商家同意捐贈飲水和點心，為慈善路跑提供支持。
lend weight to: The new research results lend weight to the idea that sleeping well helps students learn better.
新的研究結果為「睡得好有助學生學習」的看法增加了分量。
lend a hand: When I saw the old woman struggling with her heavy bags, I ran over to lend a hand.
當我看到那位老婦人提著沉重的袋子很吃力時，我跑過去幫忙。
lend itself to: This old story will lend itself to a school play because it has many characters and a clear lesson.
這個古老故事很適合用於學校話劇，因為它有很多角色和明確的寓意。
lend an ear: Whenever I feel stressed about exams, my best friend is always ready to lend an ear.
每當我為考試感到壓力時，我最好的朋友總是願意傾聽。
lend color to: The bright paintings by local children lend color to the plain gray walls of the hospital.
在地孩童畫的鮮豔畫作為醫院單調的灰牆增添了色彩。
level the playing field: Free online classes can help level the playing field for students who cannot afford private tutors.
免費的線上課程能為請不起家教的學生創造公平競爭的環境。
level criticism at: Many angry parents began to level criticism at the school for not telling them about the change earlier.
許多憤怒的家長開始對學校提出批評，因為學校沒有早點告知他們這項改變。
level a building: Workers used huge machines to level a building that had been empty for more than twenty years.
工人用巨大的機器夷平一棟已經空置二十多年的建築。
level charges against: The police decided to level charges against the driver who caused the accident and then ran away.
警方決定對那名肇事後逃逸的司機提出指控。
level off: After rising quickly for several months, house prices in the city have finally started to level off.
連續數月快速上漲後，這座城市的房價終於開始趨於平穩。
level with someone: I need you to level with me and tell me what really happened to my bike yesterday.
我需要你跟我坦白說，告訴我昨天我的腳踏車到底發生了什麼事。
